about.title: Help / About
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.scan_desc: Refreshes battery levels and discovers new devices. Notifications only fire if a device newly crosses its threshold.
settings.general.interval_desc: How often Battery Sentinel Plus polls HA for new devices and current battery levels. Range: 1 to 120 minutes.
settings.general.exclude_bn_desc: When the Battery Notes integration is also installed, its virtual battery sensors appear as duplicates in the device list. Enable this to hide them automatically.
settings.general.language_desc: Interface language. Changing this reloads the page.
settings.general.types_desc: Available in the per-device battery type dropdown. Add or remove as needed.
settings.general.lookup_desc: Uses a locally bundled copy of the Battery Notes community database to auto-fill missing battery types. No external network calls are made.
settings.display.title: Display
settings.display.col_desc: Choose which columns appear in the device list. Device name is always shown.
settings.display.colors_desc: Set the percentage thresholds where the level display changes color. Binary sensors (Low/OK) are always red or green.
settings.notifications.title: Notifications
settings.notifications.threshold_desc: Applied to any newly discovered device.
settings.notifications.persistent_label: UI notification (HA persistent) for low batteries
settings.notifications.mobile_desc: Used when a device has Mobile enabled but no specific service set.
settings.notifications.script_desc: Script to run when any device crosses its threshold. Per-device script overrides this.
settings.notifications.new_device_label: Alert when a new battery device is discovered
settings.notifications.unavailable_label: Alert when a battery device goes unavailable or unknown
settings.notifications.delay_desc: Wait this many minutes before sending any unavailable, dead-node, or offline alert. Devices that recover before the delay expires are silently ignored. A recovery alert is sent when the device comes back.
settings.notifications.suppress_label: Skip unavailable alerts for devices already covered by Z-Wave or Zigbee monitoring
settings.notifications.email_service_des: Which HA notify service sends email alerts. Select a Gmail, SMTP, or similar email-capable service.
settings.report.title: Daily Email Report
settings.report.send_if_ok_label: Send report even when all batteries are OK
settings.report.include_type_label: Include battery type in reports and notifications
settings.monitoring.title: Device Monitoring
settings.monitoring.zwave_alert_label: Alert when a Z-Wave node goes dead
settings.monitoring.zwave_alert_desc: Monitors all sensor.*_node_status entities. Fires an alert when a node is reported dead by Z-Wave JS, and a recovery alert when it comes back online. Notification channels and mute periods are configured per-node in the Z-Wave tab.
settings.monitoring.zwave_ping_desc: Every {interval} minutes. Pings alive nodes so Z-Wave JS detects failures faster. Sleeping (battery-powered) nodes are skipped.
settings.monitoring.zigbee_alert_label: Alert when a Zigbee device goes offline
settings.monitoring.zigbee_alert_desc: Monitors all sensor.*_last_seen entities created by Zigbee2MQTT. Requires last_seen to be enabled in Z2M and the Last Seen entities to be enabled in HA. Notification channels and mute periods are configured per-device in the Zigbee tab.
settings.monitoring.zigbee_threshold_des: How many hours without a check-in before a device is considered offline. Set this higher than your Z2M availability timeout.
settings.monitoring.zigbee_interval_desc: How often Battery Sentinel Plus checks Zigbee last_seen timestamps. Independent from the battery check interval.
settings.monitoring.zigbee_scan_desc: Triggers an immediate Zigbee Last Seen check without waiting for the next scan interval. Does not affect the battery or Z-Wave check cycles.
